tests.goal: Have MCP all connectors listed and available: AFR News, GIMS, KX, SharePoint, DESC, IBISWorld

steps.action: Open the Connectors menu in a chat.
Look at each MCP gateway connector.
acceptanceCriteria: AFR News, GIMS, KX, SharePoint, DESC and IBISWorld are all listed and available

steps.action: Open the MCP Settings side panel.
Search for MCP servers by name.
acceptanceCriteria: The list filters to servers matching the search term

steps.action: Enable the SharePoint tool.
Ask a question that needs SharePoint data (e.g. "list my recent SharePoint files").
acceptanceCriteria: The reply contains data retrieved from SharePoint

steps.action: Enable the research tool from the gateway.
Ask an industry research question (e.g. "What are the key growth opportunities and challenges facing the Australian Health Care Services industry in the next five years?").
acceptanceCriteria: The reply contains IBISWorld industry research
Sources are cited

steps.action: Enable the KX tool from the gateway.
Ask "Find me a digital twin qual".
acceptanceCriteria: The reply lists relevant Deloitte quals from KX

tests.goal: Pull Deloitte investment information from GIMS

steps.action: Enable the GIMS tool from the gateway.
Ask "Can I invest in Rio Tinto Aluminium Limited?".
acceptanceCriteria: The reply contains Deloitte investment information from GIMS

tests.goal: Pull Deloitte compliance information from DESC

steps.action: Enable the DESC tool from the gateway.
Ask "Can I start a project with RACQ?".
acceptanceCriteria: The reply contains compliance information from DESC

tests.goal: Pull TOPICAL news from the AFR

steps.action: Enable the news tool from the gateway.
Ask "Give me news about consulting.".
acceptanceCriteria: The reply contains topical AFR news about consulting

tests.goal: Pull RECENT news from the AFR

steps.action: Enable the news tool from the gateway.
Ask "What's today's news?".
acceptanceCriteria: The reply contains recent AFR news from today

tests.goal: My tool choice survives a model switch

steps.action: In a new chat with no agent, turn on an MCP tool.
Switch the model.
Send a message.
acceptanceCriteria: The MCP tool is still enabled after the switch
The message can use the tool

tests.goal: Add Connect All control for MCP servers

steps.action: Open a chat and open the MCP server selector dropdown. With no servers connected, look at the top of the list.
acceptanceCriteria: "Connect All" appears at the top with an empty checkbox

steps.action: Click Connect All.
acceptanceCriteria: Every selectable server becomes selected
Servers requiring OAuth or credentials request authorization
Servers requiring no authorization connect silently

steps.action: Complete any authorization.
acceptanceCriteria: The dropdown label reads "n connected", not "n selected"

steps.action: Click Connect All again.
acceptanceCriteria: All servers are deselected
The label remains "Connect All" and only its checkbox changes from checked to unchecked

steps.action: Connect some, but not all, servers.
acceptanceCriteria: The Connect All indicator shows the partial "-" state

steps.action: Open the MCP Builder side panel and click Connect on one server card.
acceptanceCriteria: It initializes or authorizes directly, or opens its custom-variable configuration first when required
No unrelated intermediate popup appears

tests.goal: Clearer errors when SharePoint files can't be attached

steps.action: Using an agent with SharePoint MCP and Code Interpreter, ask it to download a known test xlsx, attach it to Code Interpreter and report the sheet names and row counts.
acceptanceCriteria: The task completes successfully

steps.action: Duplicate the agent, turn Code Interpreter off and repeat.
acceptanceCriteria: A clear error explains why the file cannot be attached

steps.action: Hover over every MCP in the side panel and in the connector dropdown, in both dark and light mode.
acceptanceCriteria: A tooltip is shown for every MCP in both modes

steps.action: Ask "what tools are available for each connector".
acceptanceCriteria: The reply lists the tools available for each connector

tests.goal: Limits SharePoint MCP to permitted users

steps.action: As a user with access to the SharePoint group (confirm your access in the Azure portal), use the SharePoint MCP.
acceptanceCriteria: SharePoint MCP works

steps.action: As a user without access, look for the SharePoint MCP.
acceptanceCriteria: It is not available or usable

tests.goal: Clearer errors when attachments can't be resolved for upload

steps.action: Attach a file with Run Code on, modify it with Code Interpreter, then ask to upload it via SharePoint (sp_upload_file).
acceptanceCriteria: Unavailable files give recovery guidance before any SharePoint call is made
